description: Zero-dependency Python library that reports a terminal program's status (idle, working, blocked, done, error) with the OSC 7501 escape sequence, with helpers, a Job context manager and terminal feature detection.
rules: Install with pip install osc7501 (Python 3.11+) and import helpers from osc7501: working, blocked, done, error, idle, clear, encode, detect.
Reports are written to stderr only when it is a terminal; helpers return True only when bytes were written.
Each report replaces the terminal's record, so repeat app, id and title on every report you still want shown.
Call detect() before reading user input; it reads /dev/tty and can consume keystrokes typed during the wait.
For kind="auth", msg is the prompt text, never the secret.
